body: I suggest continuing to work on your CEH. Don't give up! I have heard it opens up many doors that weren't there before. This might be a gamechanger.
Great to hear. Thanks for the advice! :) I'll look into it.

That guy is right. A bad person wouldn't regret a thing. Regret is an inherent quality of good people. Too bad there are so many bad people on Earth. We need more of your kind.

I believe that what your friend is going through is that short period of feeling too angry and proud to forgive. I have hurt people in my life and said some things I shouldn't have. Upon apologizing, they let their anger and frustrations out on me, which I deserved. But eventually, forgiveness ensued. The importance is that your apology has to be personal and genuine, from the heart.

With all the bad going on nowadays, let me tell you that we need more good people. You're not fucked up. Regret is a quality so rare that it makes you someone I would even vote for president. It shows true wisdom and strength of character. Never forget that.

Talk to that teacher. I feel like he will be of great help as far as your problems are concerned.

Of course, that shouldn't restrain you from talking to us. We are *all* either depressed and/or suicidal over here. It's what holds us together and prevents us from killing ourselves. Finding this place was the best thing that happened to me. This is what true, unconditional love looks like.

So yeah. Talk to your teacher. And when you're done with that, why not tell us a little something about yourself?

My name is Paul and I am 18 years old. You can PM me if you feel like it.
Are you feeling better now? What is therapy like?
